summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration_2 (Battle VFX + SVG sprites + Tutorial). All targeted flows work on the live preview at 390x844. Login with QA account (qa.lord@example.com) lands on battle-screen; after resetting settings.tutorial_done=false the tutorial-overlay auto-appears within ~2s. All 9 steps advance in order via tutorial-next-button ('Benvenuto, Lord!' -> 'Lo Stage' -> 'Auto-battaglia' -> 'Il tuo Lord' -> 'Il Regno produce' (auto-navigates to Kingdom) -> 'Costruisci e potenzia' -> 'Code e accelerazioni' -> 'Forziere offline' (auto-navigates back to Battle) -> 'Buona conquista!'); the spotlight ring is visible around 'stage-panel' on step 2 (also verified on other steps via screenshots). Final 'Inizia!' closes the overlay; reloading the page does NOT show it again (PATCH /api/account/settings persisted tutorial_done=true). tutorial-skip-button closes the overlay from any step. Profile > replay-tutorial-button re-triggers the tutorial on the battle tab. Battle scene: lord-sprite contains SVG(s) (LordSprite), monster-horde contains multiple SVG monsters, floating damage numbers (both normal and crit '!' variants such as '273', '984!') appear/disappear inside battle-scene, battle-wave-label increments (e.g. 'Ondata 1/10 -> 10/10'), when battle finishes battle-outcome-banner shows 'VITTORIA' or 'STAGE CONQUISTATO' or 'SCONFITTA' for ~1.5s and then battle-result-card appears; auto-battle progresses (stage 25 -> 26 -> 27 -> 28). Boss stage 20 selected via stage-prev-button (auto-battle OFF, no attempt running) -> Combatti -> during the last wave the boss-bar with the region boss name 'Ogre Warlord' and a large boss sprite (Ogre) renders in monster-horde. Alliance boss (Social -> open-alliance-button -> hub-boss / direct /alliance/boss): after starting a hunt (Titan Hunt tier 1) the boss-panel renders a large SVG Ancient Titan sprite with red HP bar and 25/50/75/100% chest thresholds. Kingdom regression: kingdom-scene loads with all buildings (building-castle, building-farm, building-lumberyard, building-clay_pit, building-warehouse), tap opens building-sheet with cost/upgrade panel. Zero console errors during the full session (only ignored deprecation warnings from RN web).
action_items: No new fixes required for iteration_2 scope (battle VFX + SVG sprites + tutorial). The talents NaN% bug from iteration_1 (hero/talents.tsx:43) is still open.
critical_code_review_comments: BattleScene.tsx: kill-event effect intentionally omits color/pal from deps (kill count is the driver) — that's fine, the `// eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` documents it.
TutorialProvider.finish() fires the settings PATCH but ignores errors; safe since the overlay is dismissed regardless. Reload verifies persistence anyway.
Alliance boss screen only renders MonsterSprite when a run exists. Officer accounts see 'boss-start-panel'; non-officer members see the muted note. Nothing to change.
